title: DESIGN-LAB interop: DTCG design-token document (DL-P0-110)
description: Structural contract for a canonical Design Tokens Community Group (DTCG) 2025.10 stable token document. Groups are objects whose non-'$' members are tokens or nested groups; a token is an object carrying '$value'. Semantic rules that this schema cannot express -- $type inheritance, alias resolution, alias-cycle rejection, composite member completeness and per-type value shape -- are enforced by design_lab.interop.dtcg.validate_document, and for the typography composite that means all five members (fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight, letterSpacing, lineHeight) are required. The pre-2025.10 'string'/'boolean' token types are NOT part of this canonical schema: they are converted by the explicitly named adapter design_lab.interop.dtcg.from_legacy_document, and no flag on the canonical entry points accepts them.

token.description: A DTCG token: an object that carries $value. $type is optional at the token when an ancestor group declares it. A canonical typography $value must state all five members (fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight, letterSpacing, lineHeight); $value shape is enforced per type by design_lab.interop.dtcg.validate_document because a token may inherit $type from an ancestor group, which this schema cannot resolve.

$extensions.description: Free-form vendor extension map (DTCG reserves this key for tools).

group.description: A DTCG group: an object whose non-'$' members are tokens or nested groups. $root carries the group's own value.

rootGroup.description: The document root is a group. It may additionally pin the DTCG schema URL; a top-level $root token is not supported because it has no flattened path.
